Container.Name: playlarr
Container.Overview: Playlarr turns playlists from music subscription services into a local Lidarr-managed library and ordered M3U8 playlists. Create the single-user web password when you first open the application.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port used to access the web interface.

Config.Name: AppData Config Path
Config.Description: Playlarr workflow state and authentication data. The legacy host path is retained so upgrades preserve existing installations.

Config.Name: MusicBrainz User Agent
Config.Description: Required identifying user agent containing a real email address or URL.

Config.Name: Spotify Client ID
Config.Description: Spotify application client ID. No client secret is required.

Config.Name: Spotify Redirect URI
Config.Description: Spotify PKCE redirect URI. Register this exact application callback URL in Spotify.

Config.Name: Lidarr URL
Config.Description: URL through which the container can reach Lidarr.

Config.Name: Lidarr Root Folder
Config.Description: Root folder configured inside Lidarr; this is a logical path and does not require a volume mount.

Config.Name: Navidrome URL
Config.Description: Optional URL through which the container can reach Navidrome for read-only local playlist additions.

Config.Name: Navidrome Username
Config.Description: Navidrome username used for read-only library searches and song lookup.

Config.Name: Navidrome Password
Config.Description: Navidrome password used to generate Subsonic token authentication.
